question: Can the frozen geometry gate's FAIL_REGRESSION semantics be re-grounded on a LINEAGE-STABLE property (criterion-level pass vectors, or degradation-monotone criterion values), or must the gate be re-scoped to served_lineage only? One discriminating purpose, no threshold invented, no frozen bar touched, no Frontier candidate re-measured.

prior_accepted_evidence_this_question_bu.F5_accepted_finding: the frozen geometry gate's regression verdict is ANCHOR-DETERMINED: re-pointing the frozen predicate 'regressed iff count < anchor count' at each of the three in-scope packets produces three DIFFERENT verdict sets over one immutable population; no anchor marks itself. FAIL_REGRESSION encodes 'differs from the anchor build', not 'degraded relative to the accepted product lineage'.
prior_accepted_evidence_this_question_bu.F3_accepted_finding: the per-bundle COUNT vector conceals large bidirectional real criterion movement; five of 33 cells flip between earliest and latest with every |delta| >= 0.18 against bars of 0.25-0.60; de/PROJ_RANK degraded 0.339->0.129 against a >=0.30 bar; fr/STRUCTURE_LARGEST degraded monotonically 0.557->0.718->0.770 against a <=0.60 bar.
prior_accepted_evidence_this_question_bu.state_defined_successor_question: state/evaluation.json next_recommendation item (3): decide whether the regression semantics can be re-grounded on a lineage-stable property (criterion-level pass vectors, or degradation-monotone criteria such as fr STRUCTURE_LARGEST) or whether the gate must be re-scoped to served_lineage only.

what_was_NOT_observed_before_this_freeze: Whether the ACCEPTED hostile-geometry negative control (run_bar_gates._hostile_geometry), appended as a fourth newest lineage member, fires any S1 or S2 cell that the uncorrupted served packet does not fire. R4's outcome is genuinely unknown.

honest_disclosure_of_observation_order.freeze_immutability: No threshold, predicate, success rule, population or non-vacuity element in this file may change after the first execution. A change requires a new freeze file and a disclosed re-run, never an edit.

population.discovery_method: same discovery as the accepted sweep (evaluation/packet_lineage_sweep.discover_packets): every gate-packet directory on the accepted product mount /tmp/lex_accepted/product/results/product/gate_packet
population.in_scope_rule: packet carries all three frozen qids (de-kapitalverletzung, fr-bail-entretien, it-responsabilita-medica)

out_of_scope_recorded_with_reason_expect.offline_machinery_rehearsal: carries none of the three frozen qids

lineage_order_grounding.primary: packet.json generated_at, ascending (objective temporal production order)
lineage_order_grounding.R1_requires: the two orders are IDENTICAL; a disagreement is a finding and fails R1

S1_clean_prefix_cell_regression.definition: For cell (qid, criterion) and packet P at lineage position i (0-based, ordered by generated_at): S1_fires(P,q,c) = (NOT frozen_pass(P,q,c)) AND (frozen_pass(P_j,q,c) for ALL j < i). The first packet (i=0) can never fire (empty prefix). A cell born failing at position 0 can never fire under S1. Reference is the WHOLE prefix set, never one build.
S1_clean_prefix_cell_regression.pass_source: the frozen per-criterion boolean verdict from the ACCEPTED engine geometry_gate.score_packet; no pass/fail is re-derived
S1_clean_prefix_cell_regression.known_limitation_frozen_in_advance: S1 cannot see a deficit that predates the observed lineage window (born-failing cells) and cannot see a degradation that recurs after an intervening failure (clean-prefix rule). Those cells are the absolute bar's job, which stays REPORTED, never enforced.

S2_monotone_degradation_endpoint.definition: For cell (qid, criterion) with a STATIC scalar frozen bar and a parseable inequality direction, and numeric measured values v_0..v_k in lineage order: S2_fires(P_k,q,c) = (k >= 1) AND (v_0..v_k strictly monotone in the DEGRADING direction) AND (NOT frozen_pass(P_k,q,c)). The degrading direction is read from the frozen RULES_GEOMETRY bar string: '>=' means higher-is-better so decreasing is degrading; '<=' or '<' means lower-is-better so increasing is degrading.

excluded_by_design.COHERENCE_QUERY_LANG: dynamic bar max(0.25, 0.5*baseline): baseline moves per packet, so monotone value movement is not comparable against a constant yardstick
excluded_by_design.COHERENCE_QUERY_TERM: dynamic bar = bundle baseline: same reason
excluded_by_design.OUTLIER_VALIDITY: compound predicate, no single scalar value/bar
excluded_by_design.RELATIONS: compound predicate (edge_count AND endpoint_ok AND kind), no single scalar value/bar

S2_monotone_degradation_endpoint.known_limitation_frozen_in_advance: S2 requires at least two prior-consistent observations before the endpoint and only fires when the endpoint CROSSES the frozen bar; a monotone approach that never crosses is a warning, not a regression, and is deliberately not fired.

S3_served_lineage_membership_re_scope.definition: The re-scope option: S3_fires(P) = P is NOT the served-lineage packet whose bundles the accepted GEOMETRY_HALF.json measured (sha256 set-relation against the measured bundle shas). S3 is an identity test; it makes no degradation claim.
S3_served_lineage_membership_re_scope.purpose: the honest fallback if S1/S2 fail any of R1-R4: the gate may then only state lineage membership, and regression language is withdrawn outside that one packet.

old_semantics_for_contrast.definition: the accepted incumbent-count predicate 'regressed iff per-bundle count < anchor count', re-pointed at each in-scope packet as anchor, exactly as F5 computed it
old_semantics_for_contrast.purpose: R2 contrastive control: the OLD semantics has an explicit anchor parameter and must reproduce >= 2 distinct verdict sets; S1/S2 have NO anchor parameter and must produce exactly one verdict set each

R1_order_grounding.requirement: lineage order from packet.json generated_at is IDENTICAL to packet-id sort order, AND V_S1 and V_S2 computed under that order are the single well-defined verdict sets (there is no second order to disagree with)
R1_order_grounding.fails_if: the two orderings disagree, or either verdict set is empty AND the non-vacuity battery cannot be satisfied

R2_anchor_freedom.requirement: the OLD anchor-count semantics reproduces F5 (>= 2 distinct verdict sets across the 3 anchors) while S1 and S2 each produce exactly ONE verdict set (structural: they have no anchor parameter). Additionally the designed single-build-reference CONTROL (S1-immediate-prior variant: reference is only P_{i-1}'s mask, not the whole prefix) is computed on both the real population and the hostile-geometry extension; if it differs from full-prefix S1 anywhere, that difference is recorded as load-bearing evidence that whole-prefix reference is not equivalent to a single-build reference.
R2_anchor_freedom.fails_if: the OLD semantics does NOT reproduce >= 2 distinct anchor verdict sets (the test would be insensitive), or S1/S2 somehow require an anchor choice to produce a verdict
R2_anchor_freedom.disclosure_rule: if the S1-immediate-prior variant coincides with full-prefix S1 on BOTH the real population and the extension, R2 still holds on the structural + F5-contrast argument, but the coincidence is disclosed as a limitation of this population's power, never hidden

R3_real_degradation_detection.requirement: V_S1 union V_S2 contains BOTH accepted F3 degradations: (latest packet, de-kapitalverletzung, PROJ_RANK) and (middle or latest packet, fr-bail-entretien, STRUCTURE_LARGEST)
R3_real_degradation_detection.fails_if: either accepted real degradation is invisible to both semantics

R4_non_vacuity.requirement: the accepted hostile-geometry corruption (run_bar_gates._hostile_geometry) of the SERVED packet, appended as a FOURTH newest lineage member, fires at least one S1 or S2 cell that the uncorrupted served packet does not fire. A deliberately regressed input MUST make the semantics fail, or the whole result is void.
R4_non_vacuity.fails_if: the hostile extension fires nothing new

R5_no_new_threshold.requirement: every pass/fail is the frozen per-criterion verdict from the accepted engine; every S2 direction flag is parsed from the frozen RULES_GEOMETRY bar string; no numeric constant outside the frozen artifacts is introduced as a bar. Verified by a static scan of the module for numeric literals compared against criterion values.
R5_no_new_threshold.fails_if: an implementation bug introduces a threshold; this is classified ENVIRONMENT, not evidence, and voids the run rather than counting as MUST_RESCOPE

success_rule_frozen.REGROUNDABLE: R1 AND R2 AND R3 AND R4 all hold (R5 is a correctness precondition; its failure is ENVIRONMENT, not a verdict). The verdict names which semantics regrounded (S1, S2 or both) and discloses every known limitation of the regrounded semantics.
success_rule_frozen.MUST_RESCOPE: any of R1, R2, R3 or R4 fails. The verdict names the failing requirement and recommends the gate be re-scoped to served_lineage membership only (S3), with regression language withdrawn outside the served packet.
success_rule_frozen.ENVIRONMENT_OR_UNPROVEN: frozen RULES sha drift, empty population, any engine environment failure, or R5 failure. NOT a product verdict; suppresses every finding.

non_vacuity_battery_frozen.must: >= 1 real in-scope packet fires at least one S1 or S2 cell
non_vacuity_battery_frozen.meaning_if_broken: vacuous: a no-fire result would carry no information

non_vacuity_battery_frozen.must: the semantics do NOT fire on every packet indiscriminately (fired packets < all in-scope packets, on the real population)
non_vacuity_battery_frozen.meaning_if_broken: the semantics fires regardless of content and carries no information

non_vacuity_battery_frozen.must: the hostile-geometry extension fires a strictly larger fired-set than the uncorrupted served packet alone (this is R4 restated as the battery element)
non_vacuity_battery_frozen.meaning_if_broken: the semantics cannot detect a deliberately regressed input

non_vacuity_battery_frozen.must: the OLD semantics under the 3-anchor contrast produces >= 2 distinct verdict sets (F5 reproduction)
non_vacuity_battery_frozen.meaning_if_broken: the anchor-sensitivity test is insensitive; R2's contrast is void

non_vacuity_battery_frozen.must: both RULES files re-hash to the accepted sha256 before any scoring
non_vacuity_battery_frozen.meaning_if_broken: scoring ran against unverified frozen inputs; every statement is void

claim_ceiling: Tests the GATE's regression SEMANTICS, not the CANDIDATE. Decides only whether a lineage-stable regression property exists over the frozen bars, and if so which of S1/S2 provides it. Does NOT re-measure either Frontier candidate, does NOT touch, relax or re-derive either frozen bar, does NOT meet the absolute bars, does NOT change any exit-code contract or packet-admission wiring, and says nothing about jurist usefulness or the human product gate. A MUST_RESCOPE verdict is a first-class negative result about the gate's expressiveness, not a product regression.
deliberately_not_in_scope: the two Frontier candidates (evidence-anchored counter classifier, query-conditioned geometry candidate) are NOT re-measured
no frozen benchmark, RULES file, incumbent, verdict contract or exit-code contract is edited
the four frozen reality legs and the retrieval/counter-authority recall gates stay byte-unchanged
no product packet-admission wiring is changed from here; the recommendation is consumed by Product
the standing accepted DO-NOT-SERVE order and human_gate_ready=false are untouched
